mechanism: Ciprofloxacin may inhibit CYP1A2, potentially increasing systemic timolol exposure when absorbed from ophthalmic instillation, though localized ocular administration minimizes systemic effects.
action: Monitor for signs of beta-blockade (bradycardia, hypotension, bronchospasm) if systemic absorption occurs; ophthalmic timolol administration carries minimal interaction risk due to localized application.
